## Circular to Licensed Corporations and Associated Entities Anti-Money Laundering / Combating Terrorist Financing

The  Joint  Financial  Intelligence  Unit  ('JFIU')  of  the  HKSAR  Government  has  published information such as sanitised examples of actual money laundering cases and statistics on the number of disclosures in the 'References' section of its website http://www.info.gov.hk/police/jfiu/english/index.htm.  To preserve the confidentiality of such information,  only  authorized  persons  with  the  necessary  passwords  are  allowed  access  to such  information.  Compliance  officers  of  licensed  corporations  may  apply  to  the  JFIU  for such passwords.

By mail:

The Joint Financial Intelligence Unit G P O Box 6555 Hong Kong

By fax:

(852) 2529-4013

By e-mail:

jfiu@police.gov.hk

If you have any questions, please contact Mr. Simon Leung of the JFIU directly on 28603404.
